|lore=Hero of Nentan. Supervised construction of Echo Base on Hoth. Head of base security. At the Mos Eisley Cantina, everyone knows his name.
|joke=[[John Ratzenberger]] played Bren Derlin in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' and Cliff Clavin on ''Cheers''.<ref name="ins74-52">"Hoth Freezes Over: Who's Who in Echo Base", ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #74 (2004), p. 52. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/download/star-wars-insider-d0e5c1/star-wars-insider-d0e5c1.pdf Internet Archive]. See also the complete primary [https://web.archive.org/web/20000505095607id_/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/hoth/light/emajorbrenderlin.html Decipher Art Show], which explicitly identifies both roles.</ref> [[Decipher]]'s Art Show listed the lore line "At the Mos Eisley Cantina, everyone knows his name" among its Easter eggs.<ref name="artshow-major-bren-derlin">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000505095607id_/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/hoth/light/emajorbrenderlin.html Major Bren Derlin], Art Show: Easter Eggs, Decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000505095607/http://www.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/hoth/light/emajorbrenderlin.html Internet Archive], 5 May 2000.</ref> See [[Jokes#Major Bren Derlin|Jokes]].
